from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

files = {'A4': (595.276, 841.89), 'Letter': (612, 792)}
page_texts = []
for size, expected in files.items():
    pdf = Path(f'Shared Kitchen Kit - {size}.pdf')
    info = subprocess.check_output(['pdfinfo', str(pdf)], text=True)
    assert re.search(r'"'^Pages:'"\\s+2"'$'"', info, re.M)
    assert not re.search(r'"'^(Producer|Creator|Author|CreationDate|ModDate):'"', info, re.M)
    bbox = subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext', '-bbox', str(pdf), '-'])
    pages = ET.fromstring(bbox).findall('.//{*}page')
    assert len(pages) == 2
    for page in pages:
        width, height = (float(page.get(key)) for key in ('width', 'height'))
        assert abs(width - expected[0]) < 0.01 and abs(height - expected[1]) < 0.01
        for word in page.findall('{*}word'):
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = (float(word.get(key)) for key in ('xMin', 'yMin', 'xMax', 'yMax'))
            assert 28 < x1 < x2 < width - 28 and 28 < y1 < y2 < height - 28, word.text
    text = [' '.join(word.text for word in page.findall('{*}word')) for page in pages]
    assert all(item in text[0] and item in text[1] for item in ('Oil', 'Salt', 'Rice', 'Tea'))
    assert text[1].count('PERSONAL SHELF') == 3
    assert all(item in text[0] for item in ('LOW', 'BUYING', 'REPLENISHED', 'Circle 1'))
    page_texts.append(text)
    print(f'{size}: two correct-size pages, safe text margins, expected labels and clean metadata')
assert page_texts[0] == page_texts[1]
